functions.name: create_ships_for
functions.doc:
Ships.createShips for an allowlisted server (Base: FIREBASE_FLOW_MINTER,
 used for card checkout). `MINTER` role or owner. Same rank presets
 and purchase counting as a paid pack unless `is_free`.

 The attached NEAR pays for the recipient's storage: it is credited as
 sponsored deposit (spendable on storage, never withdrawable by the
 player, returned to the sponsor pool on unregister), so a card buyer
 needs no NEAR and can't cash out the server's deposit. The recipient
 is registered if needed; the call fails if the deposit plus any
 existing balance can't cover the new bytes.

 this call can't make it revert). Returns how many ids were scheduled.

functions.doc:

 re-prices their own ships so fleets accept them again
 (`ShipCostVersionMismatch` otherwise). Owner of every id only (HA7-08:

functions.doc:

 AI). The AI is deterministic, so a caller can't steer it; storage growth
 is charged to the match's human (their game, their bytes).

functions.name: timeout_joiner
functions.doc:
Lobbies.timeoutJoiner: the creator kicks a joiner who hasn't submitted
 a fleet within one turn time (a kick penalty applies if the creator had
 already committed theirs).

functions.name: transfer_ownership
functions.doc:
Ownable.transferOwnership, made two-step: the owner nominates, the
 nominee calls `accept_ownership`. A typo'd or unreachable account can
 therefore never take admin away (nominate again to replace it, or
 `cancel_ownership_transfer`). Roles are kept. Ownable's
 `renounceOwnership` is deliberately not offered: with no owner, code
 and rules could never change again.

functions.name: upgrade
functions.doc:

 JSON). After a real deploy the account's full-access keys are deleted,
 so this is the only way to change the code. Deploys, then runs
 `migrate` in the same follow-up receipt; if migrate fails, the deploy
 action fails with it and the old code stays.

NEAR Account Identifier.

This is a unique, syntactically valid, human-readable account identifier on the NEAR network.

[See the crate-level docs for information about validation.](index.html#account-id-rules)

Also see [Error kind precedence](AccountId#error-kind-precedence).

## Examples

``` use near_account_id::AccountId;

let alice: AccountId = "alice.near".parse().unwrap();

assert!("ƒelicia.near".parse::<AccountId>().is_err()); // (ƒ is not f) ```

cost_cap_override.description: 0 = no change to the run's cost cap (resupply nodes).

reservation.description: Reservation fleet (ships locked between combats), in roster order.

RunNodeFlags.description: The win-effect contracts, as values configured per node.

roster_hp.description: (ship id, persisted HP) for each roster ship.

Ship.description: The rules-relevant part of a ship (Types.sol `Ship` minus `owner`, which the contract keeps beside it).

active_index.description: 1-based index in its side's active list; 0 = not active.

version.description: Attributes version (0 = no stats); also the game's pin.

attributes.description: Computed with the variant's current attributes version (as fleets do).

costs_current.description: False = re-price with `sync_ship_costs` before fleet selection.
